_comment: French variety pass, archetypes over lessons 18-24 (branch feat/fr-it-variety). Each lesson keeps every existing exercise verbatim and is reordered into its assigned archetype; L19 (A) is already in A order and gains no exercise, L18/L20-L24 (B-F) each gain exactly one new `transform`. NOTE: the spec's archetype rows B-F do not name the `review` slot; every lesson keeps it, placed immediately before the closing `dictation` (its position in archetype A and in the current order). Applied by scripts/content/differentiate-first-words.py.

exercises.prompt: Which French word means “hour”?
